Audit the Boldteq marketing site at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq for content match (D12), forms (D4), shared components (D13), and CMS data integrity (D14). Output ONLY JSONL to stdout, one bug record per line, nothing else.

D12 content match per page (compare local component text vs Webflow HTML):
- /  → boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html
  - Typewriter phrases EXACT: "Ownership Driven", "Without Hiring", "On Demand"
  - 3 trust badges, 13 sections in correct order (see CLAUDE.md)
  - Pricing $999 / $1999 / $3499 (Monthly/Quarterly/Annual)
  - 8-item FAQ
- /pricing → pricing.html
  - Custom Plan CTA + ROI calculator (Startup/Growth/Enterprise presets)
- /our-works → our-works.html
  - 4 trust badges, 305px sidebar, 8/page pagination, Shopify+WordPress active
- /how-it-works → 4 stat badges, 3-step screenshots, "Designed to Remove Risk" 4 cards
- /contact → 3 info cards: sales@/support@/hr@boldteq.com, 6 form fields, success text exactly: "Thank you! Your submission has been received! Our team will get back to you within 12-24hrs."
- /beta → $299 / $599 pricing, "Your Execution Team. Live in 12 Hours." final CTA
- /careers → 4-step selection, 4 tabs, 5 job listings, 4 team testimonials
- /blog → 6 posts, category filter
- /our-mission, /book-a-demo, /scope (4 platforms × 4 tiers), /testimonials, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /newsletter, /services/* — all body copy must match Webflow HTML

D4 form audit:
- Contact form fields: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, "What Are You Looking For?" dropdown with 5 options (Start a New Project / Agency Partnership / Technical or Account Support / Join Our Team / General Inquiry), Message
- Zod validation present
- Success/error states render
- Newsletter signup: email + submit + privacy line
- Beta page form fields
- Book-a-demo Calendly embed loads
- Field labels + placeholders match Webflow

D13 shared components:
- src/components/layout/navbar.tsx
  - Sticky trigger 300px desktop / 350px mobile
  - Solutions dropdown: Web Dev (link) + UI/UX + Graphics + App Dev (Coming Soon badges)
  - "View Full Service Scope" link to /scope
  - Resources dropdown: Blog + help.boldteq.com (external)
  - CTAs: Login → portal.boldteq.com, Schedule Demo → /book-a-demo
  - Mobile sheet: 300px wide, bg #082753
- src/components/layout/footer.tsx
  - Newsletter card + 4 link cols (About/Services/Resources/Help)
  - Coming Soon badges on UI/UX, Graphics, App Dev, Affiliate
  - LinkedIn + IG + FB icons
  - "Designed with ❤️ from India 🇮🇳" copyright
- src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx
  - 🔒 Exclusive Access + 4 checkmarks
  - Founding Partner Pricing + 15-agency urgency
  - Modal close: ✕ + Esc + overlay click
- src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.tsx
- src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx
  - Default title: "Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?"
  - Padding 40px 20px 50px

D14 CMS data integrity:
- CMS Data/Boldteq - Our Works - *.csv → 21 portfolio rows surface, sorted by `order`
- CMS Data/Boldteq - Blog Posts - *.csv → 6 posts surface
- 8 portfolio categories + 6 blog categories all reachable via filters
- Slugs in src/lib/constants/portfolio.ts + portfolio-details.ts match CSV slugs
- Image paths exist (public/images/webflow/* or webflow CDN)

Output format:
{"id":"BT-####","dimension":"D4|D12|D13|D14","severity":"P0|P1|P2|P3","route":"/path","component":"src/...","line":N,"title":"...","evidence":"webflow.html:N says 'X', local says 'Y'","fix_hint":"...","estimated_minutes":N}

Severity:
- P0 = wrong price / wrong email / form field missing / CMS row missing
- P1 = wrong copy on conversion-critical section
- P2 = below-fold copy mismatch
- P3 = punctuation / casing nit

Aim for 100+ bugs. Pure JSONL output, no narration.

content.content:
1	# Boldteq Marketing Site — Webflow-to-Next.js 1:1 Conversion
2	
3	## Mission
4	Convert the Webflow-exported Boldteq marketing site into a pixel-perfect Next.js 16 implementation. The live reference is https://boldteq.com. Every page, every section, every pixel, every interaction must match the Webflow original exactly.
5	
6	## Critical Rule: READ BEFORE YOU WRITE
7	Before writing ANY component, you MUST:
8	1. Read the corresponding Webflow HTML file in `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/`
9	2. Read the exact CSS values from `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` (33,001 lines)
10	3. Extract exact padding, margins, font sizes, colors, border-radius, box-shadow, grid columns, responsive breakpoints
11	4. Use those EXACT values — do not approximate, do not use Tailwind defaults, do not guess
12	
13	## Source of Truth (in priority order)
14	1. **Live site**: https://boldteq.com — this is what the user sees. When in doubt, Playwright-screenshot the live page and match it.

147	### CSS Module Rules
148	- Extract values directly from `boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` — search for the Webflow class name
149	- Include ALL responsive breakpoints from the Webflow CSS (min-width: 1280px, 1440px AND max-width: 991px, 767px, 479px)
150	- Use `font-family: 'Roobert PRO', Arial, sans-serif` everywhere
151	- Use `composes:` for shared base styles within a module
152	- Match box-shadow, border, border-radius, padding exactly — never approximate

154	### Component Rules
155	- Use `next/image` with `fill` mode for responsive images, explicit `width`/`height` for fixed icons
156	- Set `sizes` prop accurately based on the grid column width
157	- Use `loading="eager"` and `priority` for above-fold images on page 1
158	- All interactive components are `"use client"` — keep server components for page shells

160	- Type everything — no `any`, use proper interfaces
